evidence.text: “Skills 本质就是 Prompt”在模型执行接口这一层成立，在系统工程和能力定义层面则不够完整。
最终生成的 Prompt，不等于生成 Prompt 的 Skill。前者是运行结果，后者是生成规则。

limitations: SOP, experience and method-sediment value remain less developed than control/execution arguments.
Some product/marketing generalizations have not been independently verified.
More than one wording change and only one sampled two-turn run: no causal attribution to deleting hype language.
No Jev, cognitive primitive or B/C contrast; no incremental-value or universal-model conclusion.
